independence: Automated self-assurance: the tool exercises its own code on hostile inputs. It is not a third-party audit. A truly independent assessment needs a qualified human outside the project.
verdictRule: ASSURANCE_CHECKS_PASSED_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED means every executed check behaved as specified. It is never an approval, certification or compliance statement. Any failed check gives ASSURANCE_CHECKS_FAILED. Skipped checks are listed, not counted as passes.

evidenceTiers.proves: Code behaved as specified on the listed inputs on this host and Node version.
evidenceTiers.doesNotProve: Behaviour on other inputs, hosts or future versions.

evidenceTiers.proves: Accidental or partial edits to the event log are detectable.
evidenceTiers.doesNotProve: Authorship, or integrity against an admin who rewrites the whole chain.

evidenceTiers.proves: File bytes matched at recording time.
evidenceTiers.doesNotProve: That the file content is true, complete or verified by a human.

evidenceTiers.proves: A declared dependency or MCP entry exists in an allowlisted file.
evidenceTiers.doesNotProve: That it runs in production or that the inventory is complete.

evidenceTiers.proves: A transparent weighted prioritization of declared inputs.
evidenceTiers.doesNotProve: Legal risk category, safety or harm likelihood.
